Everything that stands behind the essays, in one place — the web of connections, the people
whose work the analysis leans on, and the papers themselves.

## The Map {.section-head}

Posts cite papers; papers are written by people; posts mention people. This web is generated
straight from each piece's frontmatter. **Drag** a node to move it; **click** it to go there.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
d3 = require("d3@7")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
graph = FileAttachment("graph.json").json()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div class="graph-legend">
  <span class="lg"><i style="background:#4A6FA5"></i>Post</span>
  <span class="lg"><i style="background:#B45309"></i>Paper</span>
  <span class="lg"><i style="background:#7C6FB5"></i>Person</span>
  <span class="lg lg-line"><b></b>Cites / authored</span>
  <span class="lg lg-line"><b class="dashed"></b>Mentions</span>
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
chart = {
  const width = 920;
  const height = 440;
  const color = {post: "#4A6FA5", paper: "#B45309", person: "#7C6FB5"};

  const nodes = graph.nodes.map(d => ({...d}));
  const links = graph.edges.map(d => ({...d}));

  const sim = d3.forceSimulation(nodes)
      .force("link", d3.forceLink(links).id(d => d.id).distance(150))
      .force("charge", d3.forceManyBody().strength(-1100))
      .force("center", d3.forceCenter(width / 2, height / 2))
      .force("x", d3.forceX(width / 2).strength(0.05))
      .force("y", d3.forceY(height / 2).strength(0.07))
      .force("collide", d3.forceCollide(46));

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("style", "max-width:100%; height:auto; font-family:'DM Mono', monospace; overflow:visible;");

  const link = svg.append("g")
      .attr("stroke", "#B8B0A0")
      .attr("stroke-opacity", 0.65)
    .selectAll("line")
    .data(links).join("line")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1)
      .attr("stroke-dasharray", d => d.rel === "mentions" ? "3,3" : null);

  const node = svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("g")
    .data(nodes).join("g")
      .attr("cursor", "pointer")
      .on("click", (event, d) => { if (d.url) window.location.href = d.url; })
      .call(d3.drag()
        .on("start", (e, d) => { if (!e.active) sim.alphaTarget(0.3).restart(); d.fx = d.x; d.fy = d.y; })
        .on("drag", (e, d) => { d.fx = e.x; d.fy = e.y; })
        .on("end", (e, d) => { if (!e.active) sim.alphaTarget(0); d.fx = null; d.fy = null; }));

  node.append("circle")
      .attr("r", d => d.type === "post" ? 10 : 7)
      .attr("fill", d => color[d.type])
      .attr("stroke", "#F7F6F2")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5);

  node.append("text")
      .text(d => d.label)
      .attr("x", 13).attr("y", 4)
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .attr("fill", "#7A7A7A")
      .attr("paint-order", "stroke")
      .attr("stroke", "#F7F6F2")
      .attr("stroke-width", 3);

  node.append("title").text(d => `${d.type}: ${d.label}`);

  sim.on("tick", () => {
    link.attr("x1", d => d.source.x).attr("y1", d => d.source.y)
        .attr("x2", d => d.target.x).attr("y2", d => d.target.y);
    node.attr("transform", d => `translate(${d.x},${d.y})`);
  });

  invalidation.then(() => sim.stop());
  return svg.node();
}
```
